subject: Draft: Evaluation Commitment Canvas & Pilot Rhythm
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mia Chen <mia@helix.ai>, ops@helix.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Evaluation Commitment Canvas & Pilot Rhythm

Hi team — sharing a first-pass GDoc and a 2-slide rhythm stub for the pilot. Goal: get a compact, week-by-week MAP we can take into the customer sync on Wed. High-level asks below; details in the doc.

Why this version: Helix asked for a short acceptance path and a weekly demo cadence with clear owner responsibilities. I kept the canvas to a single page and added a \"Week 0\" readiness checklist so we can validate infra and data access before the pilot starts.

Asks:
- Marissa: please add the technical validation checkpoints under Week 0 (infra & data owners).
- Ben: confirm commercial milestones (PO timing, billing trigger).
- Jasmine: can you add a stakeholder tracker (RACI) and quick contact table?
- Mia / Ops (external): confirm the two acceptance criteria on page 1 — model accuracy threshold and latency SLA.

Attachments / links: Eval_Commitment_Canvas.gdoc (link below), Pilot_Rhythm_Slides.gslides.

Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cEvalCanvas
Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/4d5e6fPilotSlides
HubSpot: HLX-2026-004

I propose a 30-min sync on Wed 10am PT to align owners and lock the MAP. If that time doesn't work for Helix, suggest two alternatives in your reply.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Evaluation Commitment Canvas & Pilot Rhythm

Thanks Dylan — nice concise canvas. Quick notes inline and a couple of edits in the GDoc:

- Week 0: added infra checklist items (VPN/VPC peering, dataset schema sample, KMS access).
- Technical validation: added a short test plan for sample inference runs and data masking checks.
- I flagged an open item for the Helix infra lead to confirm ECS vs GKE preference.

I also suggested we add a short rollback criteria row (what stops the pilot early). Keeping it small so Helix can consume it quickly.

I can take the Week 0 owner if we want one named contact on our side for infra validation.

On Wed 10am PT I can cover the technical checklist; Ben can take commercial questions.

Marissa
VP, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear canvas. A few clarifications from Helix:

- Acceptance criteria: we agree on the accuracy threshold but need to define the evaluation dataset (we can share a 1k-sample set by Tuesday).
- Latency SLA: 95th percentile under 250ms for our typical payload — can Redwood confirm this target is realistic for the proposed model/quantization?
- Week 0 timeline: can we move the Week 0 infra checks earlier by 2 business days? Our infra team is compressed that week.

Availability for Wed: 10am PT works for me. If your team prefers, we can do 4pm PT instead (ops lead can make 4pm easier).

Mia Chen
Director of ML Ops | Helix AI

Great alignment — thanks everyone. Quick update & next steps:

- Marissa: thanks for taking Week 0 ownership. Please send the infra checklist to ops@helix.ai today; I'll copy the GDoc link into the message.
- Ben: please pin the PO trigger row in the slides; we'll present that at the sync.
- Jasmine: if you can paste a one-line RACI into the doc (Stakeholder / Role / Email), that will make the customer sync faster.
